fixture_compatibility.current_changes: Add one isolated provider regression gate for the exact archived nested single-search-button toolbar. Preserve all 384 original provider cases and 1792 assertions unchanged. The 26 new case groups cover complete original native AX and profile data, a disabled non-authoritative sibling, exact real paths and literal label, geometry, selection, ownership bindings and conditional exact query readback. Historical facts are not current Android authority; mutated frames are explicit host-only ports. No original test source is changed.

scope: Exact source successor to published c9212d5. Preserve existing profile, recovery, planning and action contracts. Exact parent/path/class/view-ID/selection/capability/membership and geometry predicates remain mandatory. The dynamic hint never selects the query. NativeAppSession, HeptaAccessibilityService, LocalTaskController, all deadlines, complete census, profile/window verification and final action checks are unchanged. Current signed build and phone outcomes require separate actual evidence.
